records.jp: あ！　日菜子ちゃん
records.en_original: Ah! Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah! Hinako.
records.en: Ah! Hinako-chan.

records.jp: 早苗。最近調子どう？
records.en_original: How have you been doing lately, Sanae?
records.en_auxiliary: How have you been doing lately, Sanae?
records.en: How have you been doing lately, Sanae?

records.jp: 別に普通だよ。料理部に出てるくらい
records.en_original: About the same as always. I don't do much outside of going to the cooking club.
records.en_auxiliary: About the same as always. I don't do much outside of going to the cooking club.
records.en: About the same as always. I don't do much outside of going to the cooking club.

records.jp: （なんだかこの間、暗かったから気になってたけど<CR>私の気のせいだったかな？）
records.en_original: (She seemed gloomy the other day, but maybe that was just my imagination...)
records.en_auxiliary: (She seemed gloomy the other day, but maybe that was just my imagination.)
records.en: (She seemed gloomy the other day, but maybe that was just my imagination...)

records.jp: でも嬉しいな。日菜子ちゃん学校に通うようになった頃に比べて<CR>話しかけてくれるようになって、もっと仲良くなりたくなったよ！
records.en_original: But I'm happy. We talk more than when you just started coming to school, so I want to to hang out with you more!
records.en_auxiliary: But I'm happy. We talk more than when you just started coming to school, so I want to hang out with you more!
records.en: But I'm happy. Compared with when you first started coming to school,<CR>you talk to me more now, Hinako-chan, and I want us to become even closer!

records.jp: ありがとう。<CR>私も早苗ともっと仲良くなりたいと思うよ
records.en_original: Thanks. I want to get to know you better, too.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks. I want to get to know you better, too.
records.en: Thanks. I want to get to know you better, too.

records.jp: そうだ、今日はもう予定ない？
records.en_original: Oh, right, are you done for the day?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, right, are you done for the day?
records.en: Oh, right, are you done for the day?

records.jp: うん。ないよ
records.en_original: Yep. No plans on my end.
records.en_auxiliary: Yep. No plans on my end.
records.en: Yep. No plans on my end.

records.jp: それじゃあ、今から……
records.en_original: In that case...
records.en_auxiliary: In that case...
records.en: In that case...

records.jp: どこかで、お話ししない？
records.en_original: Want to go somewhere to chat?
records.en_auxiliary: Want to go somewhere to chat?
records.en: Want to go somewhere to chat?

records.jp: え！　いいの？
records.en_original: Huh!? You mean it?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?! You mean it?
records.en: Huh!? You mean it?

records.jp: うん。それに今話してて思ったんだけど、<CR>私もっと早苗のことよく知りたいなって……
records.en_original: Sure. I mean, I did just say that I want to know more about you, Sanae...
records.en_auxiliary: Sure. I mean, I did just say that I want to know more about you.
records.en: Sure. I mean, I did just say that I want to know more about you, Sanae...

records.jp: 早苗は中学の頃から私のこと知っててくれたのに、<CR>私が早苗のことを知ったのはここに通うようになってからだし……
records.en_original: You remembered me from middle school, but I only knew you since I started coming here...
records.en_auxiliary: You remembered me from middle school, but I've only really known you since I started coming here.
records.en: You remembered me from middle school, but I only knew you since I started coming here...

records.jp: だから、早苗。今からファミレスで甘いものでも食べながら<CR>もっと早苗のことについて聞かせてほしいなって……
records.en_original: So, Sanae, how about we go have something sweet at the diner, and you can tell me more about yourself...
records.en_auxiliary: So, Sanae, how about we go have something sweet at the diner, and you can tell me more about yourself.
records.en: So, Sanae, how about we go have something sweet at the diner, and you can tell me more about yourself...

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃん。私、うれしいよ！<CR>私ももっと日菜子ちゃんとお喋りしたい
records.en_original: Hinako... I'd be happy to! I wanted to talk to you more too.
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako! I'd be happy to! I wanted to talk to you more, too.
records.en: Hinako-chan... I'd be happy to! I wanted to talk to you more too.

records.jp: それじゃあ、決まり。<CR>今から行こう！
records.en_original: Then it's settled. Let's get going!
records.en_auxiliary: Then, it's settled. Let's get going!
records.en: Then it's settled. Let's get going!

records.jp: おいしかったね
records.en_original: That was delicious.
records.en_auxiliary: That was delicious.
records.en: That was delicious.

records.jp: うん。おいしかった
records.en_original: Yeah, it was.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, it was.
records.en: Yeah, it was.

records.jp: 今日は日菜子ちゃんといっぱいお喋りできて<CR>楽しかったー
records.en_original: It was a lot of fun talking to you so much today, Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: It was a lot of fun talking to you so much today, Hinako.
records.en: It was a lot of fun talking to you so much today, Hinako-chan.

records.jp: 私も早苗の子供のころの話とか、<CR>好きな映画の話とか聞けて楽しかったよ
records.en_original: It was fun to hear about your childhood, favorite movies, and other stuff too.
records.en_auxiliary: It was fun to hear about your childhood, favorite movies, and other stuff, too.
records.en: It was fun to hear about your childhood, favorite movies, and other stuff too.

records.jp: （それに、なんだか早苗との距離が縮まったような気がする……）
records.en_original: (I feel like I've grown closer to Sanae...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I feel like I've grown closer to Sanae.)
records.en: (I feel like I've grown closer to Sanae...)

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃん。もっとお喋りしたいけど<CR>そろそろ帰らないと帰宅時間が遅くなっちゃうから
records.en_original: I wish we could stay and talk more, Hina, but I should probably head home.
records.en_auxiliary: I wish we could stay and talk more, Hina, but I should probably head home.
records.en: Hinako-chan, I'd love to keep talking,<CR>but I need to go or I'll get home too late.

records.jp: うん。じゃあ、帰ろっか
records.en_original: Yeah. I should head home too.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I should head home, too.
records.en: Yeah. I should head home too.

records.jp: 遊びに行こうよ
records.en_original: Let's go out somewhere.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's go out somewhere.
records.en: Let's go out somewhere.

records.jp: えっ！　ほんとに？
records.en_original: Huh!? Really?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Really?!
records.en: Huh!? Really?

records.jp: うん。私、もっと早苗のことを知りたい。<CR>早苗が私のこと中学生の時から知ってくれていたように
records.en_original: Yeah. I want to know more about you, Sanae. I mean, you've known me since middle school, I should do some catching up.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I want to know more about you. I mean, you've known me since middle school. I should do some catching up.
records.en: Yeah. I want to know more about you, Sanae. I mean, you've known me since middle school, I should do some catching up.

records.jp: だから今から買い物したりご飯食べに行ったりしようよ
records.en_original: Let's go shopping and get something to eat.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's go shopping and get something to eat.
records.en: Let's go shopping and get something to eat.

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Okay!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay!
records.en: Okay!

records.jp: おいしかったねー
records.en_original: That was delicious.
records.en_auxiliary: That was delicious.
records.en: That was delicious.

records.jp: うん。おいしかった
records.en_original: Yeah, it was.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, it was.
records.en: Yeah, it was.

records.jp: 今日は、日菜子ちゃんと遊べて楽しかったよ！
records.en_original: I had a lot of fun going out with you today, Hinako!
records.en_auxiliary: I had a lot of fun going out with you today, Hinako!
records.en: I had a lot of fun going out with you today, Hinako-chan!

records.jp: うん。私も！<CR>早苗の服の趣味とかアクセサリーの好みが知れたし
records.en_original: Yeah, same here! I got to know your tastes in clothes and accessories, too.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, same here! I got to know your tastes in clothes and accessories, too.
records.en: Yeah, same here! I got to know your tastes in clothes and accessories, too.

records.jp: 早苗の幼いころの話や中学生の時の話も聞けて、<CR>より親しくなれたようなきがするよ
records.en_original: I feel a lot closer to you after hearing about your childhood, and your time in middle school.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel a lot closer to you after hearing about your childhood and your time in middle school.
records.en: I feel a lot closer to you after hearing about your childhood, and your time in middle school.

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃんにそんな風に言ってもらえて<CR>私もほんとにうれしいよ
records.en_original: I'm really happy you feel that way, Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm really happy you feel that way, Hinako.
records.en: I'm really happy you feel that way, Hinako-chan.

records.jp: あ、もうこんな時間だ。<CR>ほんとはもっと日菜子ちゃんと話したいことがあるのに……
records.en_original: Oh, look at the time. I was hoping we could talk more, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, look at the time. I was hoping we could talk more, but...
records.en: Oh, it's this late already.<CR>There are still so many things I wanted to talk about with you, Hinako-chan...

records.jp: やっぱり楽しいことしてるとすぐに時間が経っちゃう
records.en_original: Time really does fly when you're having fun.
records.en_auxiliary: Time really does fly when you're having fun.
records.en: Time really does fly when you're having fun.

records.jp: そうだね……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: 遅くなりすぎてもまずいし、そろそろ行こっか？
records.en_original: We shouldn't stay out too late, though. Shall we?
records.en_auxiliary: We shouldn't stay out too late, though. Shall we?
records.en: We shouldn't stay out too late, though. Shall we?

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Yes!
records.en_auxiliary: Yes!
records.en: Yes!

records.jp: あ、ヒナちゃんと苗ちんだ！<CR>何してるの？
records.en_original: Ah, Hina and Nae! What are you up to?
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, Hina and Nae! What are you up to?
records.en: Ah, Hina-chan and Nae-chin! What are you up to?

records.jp: ちょっとお茶してただけだよ
records.en_original: We were just having tea.
records.en_auxiliary: We were just having tea.
records.en: We were just having tea.

records.jp: そうなんだ！　ユズたちも混ざっていい？
records.en_original: Cool! Mind if we join?
records.en_auxiliary: Cool! Mind if we join?
records.en: Really? Can Yuzu and the others join in too?

records.jp: もちろん。<CR>いいよね、早苗
records.en_original: Please do. It's okay, right, Sanae?
records.en_auxiliary: Please do. It's okay, right, Sanae?
records.en: Please do. It's okay, right, Sanae?

records.jp: え？　あ、うん……。<CR>あ、もうこんな時間。私帰らなきゃ
records.en_original: Huh? Um, sure... Oh, but it's already so late. I need to go home.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Um, sure... Oh, but it's already so late. I need to go home.
records.en: Huh? Um, sure... Oh, but it's already so late. I need to go home.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: ごめんね、日菜子ちゃん。<CR>今日は楽しかった。じゃあね
records.en_original: I'm sorry, Hinako. Today was fun. See you again.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry, Hinako. Today was fun. See you again.
records.en: I'm sorry, Hinako-chan. Today was fun. See you again.

records.jp: 変な苗ちん
records.en_original: Nae's being weird.
records.en_auxiliary: Nae's being weird.
records.en: Nae-chin's being weird.

records.jp: 早苗……
records.en_original: Sanae...
records.en_auxiliary: Sanae...
records.en: Sanae...
